admission.justification: Guarded by concept corpus unit tests; prevents unsourced mathematical claims, broken or symlink-escaping visual references, dangling or self-cyclic concept links, and non-existent Lean declaration citations.

applicability: Corpus validation of <memory>/docs/concepts/*.md against repository skeleton/ files by src/rh_pipeline/validate/concepts.py::validate_concept_corpus.
conditions: Every valid Concept Card must declare at least one entry in sources or lean_anchors, resolve every child_concepts slug without direct self-cycles while allowing mutual cycles between distinct cards, and resolve any set visual_ref to an existing file contained inside docs_root.

Every lean_anchors entry must match <skeleton_rel_path>#<DeclarationName> without a skeleton/ prefix or traversal, stay contained inside skeleton_root against symlink escapes, and match a declaration parsed via cached rh_pipeline.lean.parser.extract_declarations.
exclusions: Missing docs/concepts/ (when not a symlink) returns an empty registry with zero findings; inline directives and Level-1 jargon order are validated by src/rh_pipeline/validate/jargon.py.
statement: validate_concept_corpus loads <memory>/docs/concepts/*.md and enforces sourcing via sources or lean_anchors, child_concepts resolution rejecting self-cycles while allowing distinct mutual cycles, cached Lean skeleton anchor resolution via rh_pipeline.lean.parser, and optional visual_ref file existence under docs/.
title: Concept Card corpus sourcing, child-graph, Lean-anchor and visual_ref gate
